paragraphs.text: Are you coming to this beach party, Amy?
If you don't hurry up, we'll miss the bus.
There isn't another one for an hour after that.
Said Amy, finally coming out of the bathroom.
She asked her two best friends with a big smile.
Claire and Lisa looked at each other and started to laugh.
Amy, we're going to the Christmas party on Bondi Beach.
You can't stand up now in those shoes.
How are you going to dance all night?
You never know who we might meet.
Just because you two don't understand anything about fashion.
There were a lot of people already at the beach when they arrived.
And even though the sun was starting to go down,
This was where the three best friends wanted to be.
For two years, they planned this holiday.
And finally, after hours of studying for exams,
on Claire's 18th birthday, their plane took off
Lisa bungee jumped off a bridge in Cairns.
And Claire made them wake up really early
so that she could take photos of Ayers Rock at dawn.
But they all agreed snorkeling in the clear waters
of the great barrier reef was the best bit.
And now they were in Sydney where they planned
Next September, after this year of traveling,
Claire was going to study art and photography at university.
Claire wanted to become a photographer.
It was the only job she wanted to do.
Lisa was thinking about joining the police,
although her dad didn't know it yet.
He wanted her to study law and become a lawyer.
And Amy wanted to marry someone who was rich
so that she could go shopping all day, every day.
But now they still had another six months left
Look at all that delicious food.
It was obvious that she wanted something.
I've only got a few coins on me.
You always forget to bring enough money.
And you haven't given me back the $5 you owe me
She didn't plan to forget her money.
She went over to another group of friends.
Don't ask me for anything in future.
Later, as the party was finishing,
Amy and Claire waited for Lisa
so they could go back to the youth hostel together.
I think there might be a storm later on.
I've got a headache and I always
get a headache before a storm.
Maybe she went back to the youth hostel.
The last time I saw her was when we argued.
Perhaps she's at the hostel in bed.
Everyone else has gone and my feet are really hurting.
I told you not to wear those shoes.
When they got back, Amy opened the door to their room
with a nervous smile and said, you missed a great party.
But then she realized that Lisa wasn't in bed.
She wasn't in the bathroom either.
In the morning she'll tell us all about
some gorgeous Australian that she met at the party.
And as she heard the first sound of thunder,
she realized that her feet didn't hurt anymore.
